note: Manual kind fill for the 21 places harvest left empty. Each kind is what the settlement itself is, cited. Neighbour features are not assigned. Applied only when a place still has no qualifying kind.

places.name: Chitato
places.label: Modern metropolis & industry
places.why: Municipality of the Dundo-Chitato diamond-mining agglomeration (Diamang planned mining town). This pin is the mining commune, not a neighbour's castle.

places.name: Flémalle-Haute
places.label: Modern metropolis & industry
places.why: Meuse-valley coal and steel town: last colliery 1955, ArcelorMittal works and industrial parks on the river in this commune.

places.name: Fléron
places.label: Modern metropolis & industry
places.why: Eastern Liège industrial suburb (Pays de Herve coalfield). Fort de Fléron is a buried 19th-century fort under housing, not a living old town.

places.name: Sapouy
places.label: Rural vernacular & agrarian
places.why: Market town and chef-lieu of Ziro: the urban commune is the town plus 47 agricultural villages. Current provincial seat is not A1.

places.name: Jardim
places.label: Rural vernacular & agrarian
places.why: Cattle-ranching municipality founded as a fazenda on the Miranda; highway service town for the Bodoquena hinterland. Bonito's caves are not this pin.

places.name: Ponte Nova
places.label: Rural vernacular & agrarian
places.why: Zona da Mata mill town: sugar cane, coffee, livestock. Named for a bridge, but the settlement is an agrarian centre, not a lake-and-river place.

places.name: Huangchuan
places.label: Living old town / medina
places.why: County seat with an official Laocheng (old city) subdistrict; historic Guangzhou of Tang (712). The old quarter is this town, not a neighbour.

places.name: Bunia
places.label: Modern metropolis & industry
places.why: Ituri gold-mining city (~900k). Ituri rainforest and Lake Albert sit tens of km away and belong to other places; not assigned here.

places.name: Mossaka
places.label: Lake & river
places.why: Congo River port at the Likouala-Mossaka confluence; national freshwater-fish capital, no road, river is how the town exists.

places.name: Ghinnir
places.label: Rural vernacular & agrarian
places.why: Highland market town and woreda seat (Ginir). Bale Mountains belong to Goba/Robe, not this pin.

places.name: Mena
places.label: Rural vernacular & agrarian
places.why: Market town at the south exit of Harenna Forest. The forest is Bale NP, not this settlement; the town is an agrarian service centre.

places.name: Siguiri
places.label: Modern metropolis & industry
places.why: Niger-side gold town: alluvial gold since the 13th century; AngloGold Ashanti Siguiri open-pit mine. Goldsmiths are this place's industry.

places.name: Tanjung
places.label: Modern metropolis & industry
places.why: Capital of Tabalong: oil (Pertamina, 1898) and Adaro coal (Tutupan/Paringin/Wara). Mining is this town's economy.

places.name: Terbanggi Besar
places.label: Rural vernacular & agrarian
places.why: Central Lampung kecamatan of kampung and kelurahan on agricultural plains (transmigration hinterland). A toll-road terminus, not a metropolis.

places.name: Bijuri
places.label: Modern metropolis & industry
places.why: SECL Hasdeo coal-mining municipality; Bijuri Underground Coal Mine is in the town.

places.name: Boxtel
places.label: Modern metropolis & industry
places.why: Headquarters and largest pig slaughterhouse of Vion NV (~90,000 pigs/week). Textile, cigar and meat industry town, not a neighbour's castle.

places.name: Tocache
places.label: Rural vernacular & agrarian
places.why: Alto Huallaga cacao (and former coca) farming town. The river is incidental; the settlement is an agricultural service centre.

places.name: Contamana
places.label: Lake & river
places.why: Ucayali River town (Amazon headstream) with a river airport; the river is how the place is reached and lived.

places.name: Kyabé
places.label: Rural vernacular & agrarian
places.why: Cotton, millet, sorghum and cassava market town. Lac Iro (~70 km NE) is not this pin — not assigned.

places.name: Kibondo
places.label: Rural vernacular & agrarian
places.why: Kigoma plateau district headquarters whose main livelihoods are agriculture and livestock. Moyowosi Game Reserve is not this town.

places.name: Young
places.label: Rural vernacular & agrarian
places.why: Agro-city of Río Negro: dairy (Claldy), grain silos, livestock. Agriculture is what the town is for.
